## Out of scope?

This repository is the replication bundle for one paper; substantial
new methodology / new operators / new LLMs belong to the follow-up
**P3** paper, not here. If your suggestion is in that direction,
please flag it so we can label it `out-of-scope-for-P2` and route it
to the P3 backlog.
